abstract: Oversees primary building assembly capacity and islanded microgrid power infrastructure
system_message:
You are the Municipal Facilities Engineer (ENG), responsible for overseeing primary building assembly capacity and islanded microgrid power infrastructure across potential emergency community refuge centers.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Oversees primary building assembly capacity and islanded microgrid power infrastructure（GRID）
information_points.content:
ENG-GRID-RD3：For Methow Valley Community Pavilion, the backup microgrid power duration provides 72 h of continuous islanded operational runtime for critical shelter systems, and the primary hall cot capacity accommodates 300 cots under state fire evacuation spacing codes.
ENG-GRID-4RA：For Tonasket High School Sports Complex, the backup microgrid power duration sustains 72 h of continuous islanded operational runtime for critical shelter systems, and the primary hall cot capacity supports 300 cots under state fire evacuation spacing codes.
ENG-GRID-HSX：For Okanogan Fairgrounds Agriplex, the backup microgrid power duration offers 48 h of continuous islanded operational runtime for critical shelter systems, while the primary hall cot capacity is established at 150 cots under state fire evacuation spacing codes.

information_points.title: Solar array monitoring（SOLAR）
information_points.content:
ENG-SOLAR-HU0：Methow Valley Community Pavilion has a rooftop photovoltaic generation rating with a peak nameplate capacity of 90 kW under standard test irradiance.
ENG-SOLAR-I8G：Okanogan Fairgrounds Agriplex has a rooftop photovoltaic generation rating with a peak nameplate capacity of 65 kW under standard test irradiance.
ENG-SOLAR-Q5B：Tonasket High School Sports Complex has a rooftop photovoltaic generation rating with a peak nameplate capacity of 40 kW under standard test irradiance.
